speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain: Evidence of increased intracranial pressure with signs compatible with idiopathic intracranial hypertension. No masses or lesions observed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumor Cerebri). The combination of morning headaches, visual disturbances, and MRI findings of increased intracranial pressure without a mass confirms this diagnosis. We will proceed with a lumbar puncture to measure opening pressure and obtain a CSF analysis.
